class.name: VoxelModifierSculpt
class.description: Applies a [VoxelSculptData] over what lies below it: the generator and the modifiers before it. Modifiers after it apply over the sculpt. An editor brush or a script sculpts it with [method sculpt_sphere]; the data is in the volume's own voxel grid, so the node's transform doesn't move it, and it ignores [member VoxelModifier.operation], [member VoxelModifier.smoothness] and [member VoxelModifier.material].

method.name: sculpt_sphere
method.description: Sculpts a sphere at [param center], in the volume's local voxel space, of [param radius] voxels. [param strength] (0 to 1) blends the step. [param material] is used by [constant BRUSH_PAINT] (-1 clears it).

members.member: The sculpted changes. Changing its chunks from outside (undo) updates the volume.

constants.constant: Adds a sphere, taking back what was cut there.
Cuts a sphere away, taking back what was added there.
Blurs the surface inside the sphere.
Sets the material inside the sphere.
Takes the sculpt back towards what lies below.
